meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 az quota CLI 查询和管理你订阅的 Azure 配额(服务限制):列出各资源提供方与区域的限额、当前用量和可用容量,对比区域,并可提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你提到「check quotas」「service limits」「quota exceeded」等关键词,或在规划部署、选择区域、校验容量时接管。

say.text: 查一下我订阅在 eastus 的 Microsoft.Compute 配额和用量
say.note: 返回限额、用量、可用容量表

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 可用配额
say.note: 给出各区域的限额与剩余容量

say.text: 帮我把 eastus 的 vCPU 配额提高到 500
say.note: 提交调整请求并查看审批状态

howto.what_en: After install, Claude checks and manages your Azure quotas (service limits) with the az quota CLI: listing limits, current usage, and available capacity per provider and region, comparing regions, and filing quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "check quotas", "service limits", "quota exceeded" and similar terms, or when planning a deployment, choosing a region, or validating capacity.

say_en.text: Check my Microsoft.Compute quotas and usage in eastus
Compare available vCPU quota in eastus and westus2
say_en.note: Shows limits and remaining capacity per region

say_en.text: Raise my eastus vCPU quota to 500
say_en.note: Submits the request and shows its status
